messages:
Maya S: @Sam @Alex PrismBank emailed — they need SOC2 artifacts + signed pen-test letter for a POC procurement review. Deadline: next Tue EOD. Can we deliver? Link to request: https://drive.redwood/prismbank-request
Mark T (PrismBank): thanks Maya, correct — SOC2 Type II attestation, control mapping, and a signed pen-test confirmation letter (they don't need the full report, redacted is fine). We need something official for procurement by 2026-03-31.
Sam R: quick Q — is the POC hosted on Redwood Hosted API or will they require Dedicated/Private? scope affects what we can hand over.
Mark T (PrismBank): final POC will run in their VPC (private). For procurement they just want assurance artifacts now.
Alex K: flags: for pen-test letter we need legal approval + copy signed by vendor legal. We can produce a vendor pen-test attestation letter (date of last test, high-level scope). Full report or detailed vuln list requires NDA and approval from our testing vendor.
Elena G: @Alex correct. Also we usually need a PO/SOW or equivalent before committing to sign any liability-related docs. We can draft the letter but legal sign-off depends on contract terms.
Priya N: SOC2 Type II attestation (pdf) and a controls matrix export are fine to share. I can pull attestation and a control mapping within 48 hours. For ISO artifacts — do they need ISO cert or just statement of compliance?
Mark T (PrismBank): ISO 27001 cert would be nice but not mandatory. SOC2 is primary. Pen-test letter must explicitly reference our intended deployment model (private/VPC).
Maya S: action items then: Priya pulls SOC2 + control matrix, Elena drafts pen-test letter template for legal review, Alex to confirm last pen-test date and what summary we can include, Sam to estimate lead time & pricing for dedicating a sandbox VPC POC if they want.
Sam R: rough pricing note: Dedicated POC (4x GPUs, 2 weeks) estimate = $9k - $12k depending on burst. Lead time for Dedicated: ~3 weeks to provision. If procurement needs artifacts before provisioning, we'll still provide attestation but on-prem specifics might need an on-prem package.
Alex K: last internal pen-test: 2025-11-15 by SentinelSec. We can state that in the letter and include a one-paragraph summary of findings (no PII). We cannot assert "no high severity findings" unless the vendor report explicitly says so.
Elena G: drafting checklist for the pen-test letter. Pls confirm answers for these fields so I can populate the template:
```
- Customer name to reference (exact):
- Deployment model: (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC):
- Purpose of letter: (procurement / compliance / internal):
- PO or SOW available? (yes/no):
```
Maya S: I'll confirm exact customer legal name and chase PO.
Mark T (PrismBank): legal name: PrismBank, Inc. We'll try to get a PO but procurement needs the signed letter to proceed faster.
Priya N: timeline estimate: SOC2 attestation + control matrix = 48 business hours; pen-test letter draft = 5 business days after we get deployment model and PO guidance; redacted report = NDA + 10 business days (dependent on vendor).
Maya S: noted. Mark — we'll aim to get SOC2 in 48h and a draft pen-test letter within 5 business days. If you can nudge procurement on a provisional PO that helps speed Elena's sign-off.
Mark T (PrismBank): will do. One ask — can the pen-test letter include the scope lines: 'external network, API endpoints, and container runtime'?
Alex K: yes we can include that scope if it matches the 2025 test. If they want additional scope, we'll need a new test or explicit exception.
Elena G: once I have the PO status and confirmed scope I'll circulate a draft for internal review.
Maya S: ok team — I'll gather PO and confirm scope with Mark. Priya please pull attestation now. Alex please prep the vendor summary. Elena you'll own the letter draft. I'll update PrismBank. :thumbsup:
Mark T (PrismBank): thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
docs-bot: Attestation PDF link created: https://docs.redwood/soc2/prismbank_attestation_2025.pdf (access: prismbank@prismbank.com)
Sam R: FYI — if procurement asks for pricing for Dedicated POC upfront, use the $9k baseline and note it's estimate.
Maya S: copying notes into the CRM and opening a compliance handoff ticket. Will post thread update when attestation pulled.
Mark T (PrismBank): received. Looking forward to the draft letter.
Elena G: drafted initial pen-test letter template and uploaded to legal drive. I'll share once PO confirmed.
Maya S: closing loop — first deliverable SOC2 attestation link sent to PrismBank. Next deliverable pen-test draft due by next Thu (business day schedule).
Mark T (PrismBank): confirmed receipt of attestation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
